Description:
You step inside the magic circle, and an incantation of fire, frost, and lightning begins. The figure with robes and glowing eyes moves around, raw energy emanating from their palms. A book lays open on the floor, pages flipping themselves and shifting through bright violet runes. The circle is abruptly broken, and the magic stops, as you notice the Sorcerer caressing his beard, eyes all on you. Did the spell fail? Could this be a mistake? An error in the code of arcane? Sorcerers work in mysterious ways...
You are magic: not a student of it, not a wielder of it. Magic is your blood, your breath, your pulse.
Where wizards study and warlocks bargain, you erupt. Your power doesn’t ask permission. It happens.
Quick Note:
You are magic: not a student of it, not a wielder of it. Magic is your blood, your breath, your pulse.
Where wizards study and warlocks bargain, you erupt. Your power doesn’t ask permission. It happens.
Weapons: You are Trained in a Weapon Category of choice (e.g. One-Handed Melee, Two-Handed Ranged, etc).

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Sorcerer-specific Abilities are considered Spells (except Magic Mastery).

Starting Abilities Description.Unstable Spark: As a Sorcerer (or Sorceress), your bread-and-butter feature is the Unstable Spark die: your aim is to have it trigger as many times as possible, and add as many effects to it as you can! Many of your Abilities will make you roll more Unstable Spark dice, which are used in more ways than just determining what effect happens on that number. You'll see!

Starting Abilities Description.Flux: Whenever you see Flux Type, it just means the element you chose. If you chose Fire, "Flux" means exactly "Fire".

~Unstable Spark~.Effect:
At the start of your every Turn in a Worthy Combat, roll 1d10. Apply any effects you have.
Other Talents will add extra effects to your Unstable Spark die.

{Spark(1)} you take 1d6 True Damage.
{Spark(10)} your next Spell this Turn has +50% Damage.
~Unstable Spark~.Upgrade: The Color('orange' 'orange d10') icon on a Sorcerer Ability means that effect triggers when you roll that number on the Unstable Spark die.
~Unstable Spark~.Notes: The triggered {Spark(numbers)} may or may not overlap.
~Unstable Spark~.Name: ~Unstable Spark~

~Overcharge~.Effect: Permanently learn one Level 1 Sorcerer Talent.
~Overcharge~.Notes: You may use this as many times as you want, until you learn all Level 1 Sorcerer Talents (works for both Utility or Class Talents). The {Mana}Mana spent is restored inbetween Adventures as usual. You can't replace the permanently learned Spell inbetween Adventures... and why would you, anyway?
~Overcharge~.Name: ~Overcharge~

~Flux~.Effect: Choose a Damage Type from the ones listed below. That becomes your {Color('orange' 'Flux')} Type. Some of your Spells's Damage deal that Damage Type (written explicitly on those Spells).
~Flux~.Upgrade:
1. Fire, 2. Cold, 3. Shock, 4. Pulse, 5. Poison, 6. Acid, 7. Divine, 8. Scourge.
You can change your Flux inbetween Adventures.
~Flux~.Name: ~Flux~
